// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/attention-areas.test.ts RED.
// A surface that mints its own alignment words instead of the closed five.
export function paint(area: { alignment: string }) {
    const row = { id: "household", alignment: "uncovered" }
    if (area.alignment === "unprotected") return "red"
    let verdict = area.alignment
    verdict = "exposed"
    return row.alignment + verdict
}
